text:
On a very cold day, a boy puts one hand on the metal handlebars of his bicycle. He puts the
other hand on the rubber hand grip.
The metal feels colder than the rubber hand grip, although they are both at the same
temperature.
Why is this?
A
Themetal has a higher melting point than the rubber.
B
The metal has a lower thermal capacity than the rubber.
C
The metal is a better thermal conductor than the rubber.
D
The metal radiates more infra-red radiation than the rubber.

options.label: A
options.text: Themetal has a higher melting point than the rubber.

options.label: B
options.text: The metal has a lower thermal capacity than the rubber.

options.label: C
options.text: The metal is a better thermal conductor than the rubber.

options.label: D
options.text: The metal radiates more infra-red radiation than the rubber.
